description.en: Significant reduction in cheek width, jaw alignment, and cheekbone symmetry after 4 sessions.
description.zh: 進行4次小顏療程後，顴骨寬度明顯內收，下頜輪廓更具V字感，左右平衡度大幅提升。

description.en: 8-session journey showcasing nose bridge elevation, nasolabial folds reduction, and skin firming.
description.zh: 8次療程的完整蛻變：鼻樑視覺上顯得更高挺，法令紋與笑紋顯著減淡，面部組織整體提拉。

description.en: Long term maintenance result showing sustained face slimming and tone over 12 months.
description.zh: 維持期保養對照：每月一次的例行微調，使精緻的小顏曲線在一年後依然保持完美不反彈。
